purpose: Prospectively test whether an explicit tagged span protocol plus source-independent wrapper normalization removes v59 format failures while leaving its FRC family, budgets, metrics and development gates unchanged on a third disjoint train sample.

mechanism.prompt_output: Exactly one line: SPAN: <shortest exact copied answer span>, or UNSUPPORTED.
parser_order: Trim Unicode whitespace and inspect the first non-empty line.
If that line begins with the standalone token UNSUPPORTED, reject.
Otherwise remove one leading SPAN: or ANSWER: tag, trim paired surrounding quotes or backticks, and accept when the remainder is a non-empty case-insensitive contiguous paragraph substring.
If tagged parsing fails, accept the first paired quoted or backticked segment in the output that is a non-empty paragraph substring.
Otherwise fail closed as invalid and reject.
mechanism.parser_design_boundary: Rules are generic format normalization fixed without reading any v59 raw output.
mechanism.shared_gate: One parsed decision per case reused for every budget and downstream method.
mechanism.downstream_freeze: Reuse v59 method identifiers, v43 candidate, selectors, budgets, metrics, bootstrap and all numerical gates exactly; v60 changes only the new disjoint sample and support-output protocol.

source_and_split.development: train-v2.0.json excluding the union of all v58 and v59 development source-case commitments

access_order: Freeze protocol, parser, implementation and synthetic invariants before constructing the v60 sample.
Read only source-case commitment hashes from the v58 and v59 candidate maps and verify the union contains 1,200 unique commitments.
Construct a zero-overlap train blind sample and register every cache, runtime and model hash before scoring or generation.
Complete BGE and structured-span generation before gold join.
Run the unchanged v59 numerical gates once. Open dev only if every gate passes.

models.bge_stack: Identical frozen v58/v59 offline embedding and reranker stack

frozen_structured_prompt:
Determine whether the paragraph contains a contiguous span that directly answers the requested fact. Return exactly one line in one of these forms:
SPAN: <copy the shortest exact answer span from the paragraph>
UNSUPPORTED
Do not add explanation, markdown, quotation commentary, or outside knowledge. Use UNSUPPORTED for a related topic, a plausible guess, or an unstated assumption.

Question: {question}

Paragraph:
{context}

Output:

downstream_methods_and_evaluation.answer_metric: evidence-unit set F1, not answer-string EM/F1

scope_limits: Balanced public closed-paragraph mechanism evidence; not official answer-string scoring, hidden-test submission, SetR reproduction, flood-domain validation or rollout authorization.
